notes.title: Standable v2.1.1 PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
Mini Patch Notes for Standable [b]v2.1.1[/b]!

v2.1.1 has only a few bug fixes and updates, but very important nonetheless!

Patch Notes below:

[h2]One Handed/Controller Calibration[/h2]
If a controller dies or you are unable to use two controllers for whatever reasons Standable calibration will still work as intended with only one controller connected (t-pose, alignment options, etc).

[i]Note: Two controllers must be connected at the beginning of each session, but after initial connection you are free to turn one of the controllers off.[/i]

[h2]Anti Virus Fixes[/h2]
There have been multiple reports of Standable triggering Anti-Virus programs (specifically McAfee). These triggers have been mitigated and [b]Standable now no longer falsely triggers Anti-Virus Programs[/b] (or at least not the most popular ones. There will be edge cases where it still could).

[h2]Other[/h2]
- [b]Fixed:[/b] Standable no longer spams the Steam Console when an HMD is not detected.

notes.title: Need Help with Standable?
notes.notes:
We've noticed there's a lot of people who could use some help getting Standable working, or have questions about the program!

As a solo developer I am unable to help every single person individually, so if we aren't able to get you help directly, [b]it's not personal[/b]. Despite this, I have a few ways you can get the help you need!


[h2]Standable Docs (Recommended)[/h2]
Standable Docs ([url=https://standablevr.com]standablevr.com[/url]) is the new hub for all things Standable. Almost any question about Standable can be answered here, and we did our best to make it as user friendly as possible (let us know how we can improve it!)

The Manual/Docs are divided into [b]5 main sections[/b]: 
[list]
[*] [b]Quick Start[/b]: Installation, Calibration, and General Use.
[*] [b]Mixed Tracking:[/b] Learn how to setup Mixed Tracking w/ Standable.
[*] [b]Settings Overview:[/b] Don't know what that setting does? Let us explain.
[*] [b]FAQ:[/b] Answers to frequently asked questions.
[*] [b]Common Issues:[/b] Fixes for common issues.
[/list]
Check it out here: [url=https://standablevr.com]StandableVR.com[/url]
[i](The link can also be found in the Standable UI by pressing "Online Manual" at the bottom of the UI.)[/i]

[h2]Standable Support on Discord[/h2]
I have a few volunteer (and one paid) Official Tech Support in the [url=https://discord.gg/WPS2rWNJxG]Standable Discord[/url] that can assist. Though we ask that you thoroughly look through the Standable Docs [b]BEFORE[/b] creating a ticket on the discord as 95% of issues are extremely common and have a simple fix/answer.




[h3]"Why not use the Steam community hub and answer questions here?"[/h3]
With limited people to assist in helping users with their issues, we need to optimize how we manage support tickets. Steam's Community Hub is great for community posts but we prefer to use Discord due to our familiarity with the platform and we believe it helps us get answers to you faster.

notes.title: Standable v2.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Patch v2.0.1 is now live![/b]

[b]UI:[/b]
[list]
[*]QuickStart Guide link in UI now flashes yellow for first time users.
[/list]

[b]Calibrate Floor Button:[/b]
[list]
[*]New Button in advanced settings for quick floor setting without need to stand up.
[/list]

[b]Virtual Desktop Jitter (temporary) Workaround:[/b]
There is an issue that arises sometimes when using Virtual Desktop where Standable's DeltaTime is somehow messed up. This can slightly or severely affect Standable's tracker velocity math (depending on unknown variables).

To temporarily mitigate the issues while I search for the root cause, I've added a new section `Virtual Desktop` in advanced settings with two new settings:

[b]Auto Detect VD Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]This attempts to detect the incorrect deltatimes and auto disables the tracker velocity math.
[/list]

[b]Disable Velocity Math:[/b]
[list]
[*]This will manually disable the velocity math (use if auto detect doesn't help). "Auto Detect VD Issues" must be disabled for this to make any difference.
[/list]

Again, this is a workaround and a full fix is being looked into.

[b]Other:[/b]
[list]
[*]Removed DT Override setting
[/list]

That's all for now! Let me know how things go!

notes.title: v2.0 Release: please be patient as things get ironed out.
notes.notes:
There are a LOT of questions and getting used to the new systems. Remember to watch the (not so quick) [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hvShfPmjzo8]QuickStart Guide[/url] before creating a support ticket to make it easier on our volunteer support.

I plan on releasing a v2.0.1 (or v2.1) patch in the new few days to help solve some issues. As well as multiple patches over the next few weeks to iron even more out.

One of the biggest issues is a bunch of jittery movement and lag when using Virtual Desktop. This is being actively looked into and I hope to get a workaround out in v2.0.1 in the meantime while I look into the root cause.

v2.0 is quite a bit more complex to use than v1.1, so please be patient with us and be patient with the software as you learn all the quirks it has and how it differs from v2.0.

That's all for now.

notes.title: Standable Full Body Estimation v2.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Standable v2.0 is a full rewrite of Standable: Full Body Estimation.[/b] This gave the opportunity to add new systems like Seat Estimation and Mixed Tracking, but it also gave the opportunity to vastly improve what was already there, adding that bit much more polish. Hope you enjoy!

Make sure to watch through the (not so quick) [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hvShfPmjzo8]QuickStart Guide[/url] video to get a grasp of how to use v2.0!

[h2]All New User Interface[/h2]
[b]Fresh new UI[/b] to personalize your Standable experience to your liking.
[list]
    [*]Sit/Lay Pose Adjustment sliders for more control over your pose.
    [*]Adjustable hip sway and hip counterbalance movement.
    [*]Enable/Disable Trackers on the fly without restarting.
    [*]New tracker models that dynamically change color based on tracking status.
    [*]Over 30 new tracker icons to represent the Standable virtual trackers. We like to call them "Standabuddies".[/list]
[h2]IK/Estimation Improvements[/h2]
[b]Rewritten from the ground up[/b] for a better more immersive experience.
[list]
    [*]Implemented Smart Lay Rotation (no more body weirdly following your hands!).
    [*]Improved Lay/Body Rolling.
    [*]Improved walk gait naturalness.
    [*]Smoothed out transitions between poses.
    [*] + more![/list]
[h3]New Advanced Estimation Options[/h3]
[list]
[b]New Seat Estimation:[/b] Sit down on a chair or other surfaces and Standable will now blend into a proper seated pose!
[b]Advanced Chest Estimation:[/b] Put hands near shoulders to dynamically move the chest.[/list]
[h2]Mixed Tracking[/h2]
[b]Have real FBT devices?[/b] Combine them with Standable for the best of both worlds!
[list]
    [*]Fill in the gaps using Standable!
    [*]Enable fallback triggers to allow linked FBT devices to fallback to Standable.
    [*]Smooth out tracker data [i](currently only basic interpolation. More advanced methods will be implemented in future updates).[/i][/list]
[h3]Quick Consistent Calibration[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Align the Standable skeleton to your avatar using new Alignment options for consistent and accurate calibration.
    [*]Pencil Pose for quick mixed tracking calibration.
    [*]Smart Offsets for consistent mixed tracking calibration.[/list]
[h2]And much more![/h2]
Not everything in v2.0 is mentioned here in the patch notes. If you have issues with v2.0 or want to join the awesome Standable community, feel free to join the [url=https://discord.gg/kz69uH5dpK]Official Standable Discord[/url]!

It has been a long journey building Standable v2.0. I want to thank all of my Patreon members for their continued support throughout this past year and the wonderful Beta Testers for breaking my horrible code. [b]Standable v2.0 would not exist if it weren't for them <3[/b]

notes.title: Standable: 1 Year Anniversary Meetup!
notes.notes:
Some of you will know that May 8th is a special day for Standable. [b]May 8th will mark the 1 year anniversary for Standable v1.0[/b] on Steam!

During the meetup I will be providing a [b]first look at the upcoming v2.0 update[/b] followed by a Q&A session. A few of the v2.0 beta testers will also be attending to give their thoughts on v2.0.

I expect we may have multiple [b]full VRC instances[/b], so [b]be prepared to fight for a spot[/b] in the instances.

I will provide more detailed info on what exactly will go down during the meetup in the next few days on the official discord as we gauge interest ([b]make sure to rsvp for our headcount in the discord:[/b] [url=https://discord.com/events/1021412983240405012/1235291654177554563]HERE[/url])

notes.title: Patch Notes for May 14 (v1.1)
notes.notes:
[u][b]Additions[/b][/u]
[b]
•  Rotating logic breakthrough![/b] - While working on the small bugs I accidentally came across a huge issue with my code. After a simple variable change, now turning around is much more natural! This also fixes most cases of the legs randomly crossing. v1.1 feels so much more natural to "puppet"!

[b]• Calibration message[/b] - Calibration notification when in calibration mode (For VRChat make sure to set tracker visualization to "system" in to see it in-game)

[b]• Improved laying pose[/b] - Much more natural laying/prone look (requires to set "lock all" in VRChat settings)

[b]• Slightly improved sitting pose[/b] - Not as scrunched as before 🤷‍♂️

[b]• Selectively disable trackers[/b] - while you wait for a proper UI in v2.0 you can disable specific tracker points by changing the sfbe_settings.txt located in the sfbe plugin's folder*

————————————————————

[u][b]Changes
[/b][/u]
[b]•  Set floor level change[/b] - To set the floor level now only needs you to be 4 foot (120 cm) [b]away [/b]from the controllers (still have to be set close to each other) instead of [b]above [/b]the controllers

[b]•  Knees and Elbows[/b] - Knees and elbows pulled in some more to be more obvious what they are

[b]•  Starts in calibration mode[/b] - Opening SteamVR automatically starts SFBE in calibration mode

[b]•  Updated executable[/b] - The sfbe.exe (previously launch_steamvr.exe) executable now launches automatically with SteamVR (and thus allows for a proper playtime counter!)

————————————————————

[b][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/b]

•  Fixed Vive wand support issue (HTC Vive users rejoice!)

•  Steam now tracks your playtime using Standable
